YOU NEED A HUG! 😭🐥

Migration (2023) is a fun animated adventure about a family of ducks who decide to leave their home in New England and fly all the way to Jamaica.

The story follows the overprotective dad, who has always wanted to keep his family safe, as he finally agrees to step outside their comfort zone and see the world.

It’s funny, colorful, and full of adventure, but at its heart, the movie is about facing your fears, taking risks, and realizing that sometimes you have to leave what’s familiar to discover something new.

source_details.synopsis: Migration is a 2023 American animated adventure comedy film directed by Benjamin Renner and written by Mike White, from a story they developed. Produced by Illumination and Universal Pictures, the film stars the voices of Kumail Nanjiani, Elizabeth Banks, Keegan-Michael Key, Awkwafina, and Danny DeVito. The story follows a family of mallards who try to convince their overprotective father to go on a vacation of a lifetime and attempt to migrate from New England, through New York City, to Jamaica.
